snippet.title: Elemental Labyrinth - A Tower Defense Game with Path Building & Tower Fusion
snippet.description:
Demo is live now – give it a try!

Elemental Labyrinth is a tower defense game where you build your own maze, summon random elemental spirits, and fuse them into powerful forms to stop relentless enemy waves.

🛡️ Features:
🔸 Co-op multiplayer support
🔸 Full controller compatibility
